# laravelforge_servers (Resource)

Create a new server in the organization. Supports both standard cloud providers and custom VPS configurations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelforge_servers" "example" {
  cloud_provider = "ocean2"
  name           = "example-name"
  organization   = "my-org"
  type           = "app"
  ubuntu_version = "22.04"
}
```

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravelforge_servers.example my-org/123
```
